title: 内角两面短伸手
description: 赛璐璐风格呈现向另一面墙的短伸手，支撑脚和大手点均明确。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: Create an original cel-shaded illustration of a fictional adult reaching a short distance from one face of a shallow indoor corner to the other. One hand stays on a broad violet jug, both shoes engage clear positive low footholds, and the reaching arm approaches a nearby rounded hold without overextension. The torso turns modestly while the knees and hips remain natural. Frame the whole opaque-clothed adult in a medium-wide three-quarter view with both wall planes and continuous crash mats visible. Crisp indigo outlines, pale lilac surfaces, and warm coral accents give the scene an original animated feel. No lettering, brands, jumping, extreme splits, or dangerous exposure.
